description: This file contains unit tests for the HPACK header compression and decompression in HTTP/2, specifically testing round-trip encoding/decoding with various input splits and header sets.

classes.name: HpackRoundTripTest
classes.description: A test class for verifying HPACK header encoding and decoding round-trip integrity under different input split scenarios.

methods.name: SetUp
methods.description: Initializes the encoder and decoder with a small header table size to test eviction handling.

methods.name: RoundTrip
methods.description: Encodes a header set and attempts to decode it, verifying the decoded headers match the original.

methods.name: SampleExponential
methods.description: Samples a value based on an exponential distribution, used for randomized testing.
